name: jev-rules
description: Jev picks which of your rules apply to each prompt, so Claude only sees the ones that matter.

show_picks.title: Show Jev's picks
show_picks.description: on shows one line under each prompt, and before an edit that brings a rule, naming what Claude was given and Jev's score for each. off keeps the conversation as it was.

pane_opens.title: Rules pane opens
pane_opens.description: Applies once the rules pane is switched on (/jev-rules:pane, or CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json). on-first-pick opens the rules pane by itself the first time Jev picks a rule in a session, when the window is wide enough to show it beside the conversation. only-with-command waits for /rules.
